name: Luuk Herssen

tierList.prydwen: T0 Tower of Adversity, T1.5 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: 5-star Spectro Gauntlets aerial-combat Main DPS with one of the strongest single-hit Ultimate nukes in the game. Casts 3 enhanced Skills (Ring/Breach/Glare) from mid-air attack strings to build Endnotes on the Endgame (+25% Ultimate DMG each, up to 3 stacks), then a plunging Gavel of Earthshaker before unleashing his Ultimate. Fully locked into a single ~24-25s rotation - no quickswap possible.

skills.normalAttack: Basic Attack - Such is Light (4 hits) / Mid-air Attack (Dissection via Basic or Resection via Jump, 4 stages).
skills.resonanceSkill: Golden Reflux (2 charges) baseline; after Basic 4/Mid-air 3 becomes Aureole of Execution with 3 rotating forms (Ring/Breach/Glare).
skills.forte: Spark from the Frost - governs Ichor Flow (max 300) and the Aureate Judge state (full Ichor Flow, +110% Aureole of Execution DMG).
skills.liberation: Rewritten in Winter's Margins - massive single-hit Spectro nuke, scaled by Endnotes on the Endgame stacks.
skills.intro: Before Injection of Dawn - restores 100 Ichor Flow, grants a Dawnlit Keep damage-reduction stack.
skills.outro: Bow to the Last Light - 500% ATK Spectro hit.

echoSet: Rite of Gilded Revelation (100%, best - up to 40% Spectro DMG + 40% Basic DMG on Ultimate)

teams.name: Best Team
teams.notes: Denia is strongest (extra Tune Strain, buffing, grouping, fast rotation); Lynae close second; Sanhua a fully free budget option (may need an extra Mid-air chain post-Ultimate to hit his 25s cooldown).

rotation: Intro -> Jump Mid-air: Resection 2,3 -> Skill: Ring -> Golden Impale (dash-cancel) -> Basic Mid-air 1 -> Resection 2,3 -> Skill: Breach -> Golden Impale (dash-cancel) -> Basic Mid-air 1 -> Resection 2,3 -> Skill: Glare -> Gavel of Earthshaker (cancel via Ultimate) -> Ultimate -> Skill (swap) -> Outro.
communityNotes: Prydwen: one of the most accessible DPS in the game - performs well on a fully F2P weapon and free teammate (Sanhua) - with a huge, satisfying Ultimate nuke, but strictly single-rotation (any swap mid-combo breaks his entire kit) and weak in multi-wave content without Denia's grouping.
